content.title: How Does University of Southern California Rank Among America's Best Colleges?
content.text: University of Southern California is a private institution that was founded in 1880. In the 2026 edition of Best Colleges, University of Southern California is ranked No. #28 in National Universities. It's also ranked No. #10 in Lowest Acceptance Rates. It has a total undergraduate enrollment of 20,630 (fall 2024), and the campus size is 226 acres. The student-faculty ratio at University of Southern California is 8:1. University of Southern California accepts the Common Application and has a test-optional admissions policy. The school's tuition and fees are $75,162. Forty-one percent of first-year students receive need-based financial aid, and the average net price for federal loan recipients is $29,462. The four-year graduation rate is 74%. Six years after graduation, the median salary for graduates is $74,461.University of Southern California is a private institution that was founded in 1880.
